cargo-crate.why: reads instantly as a box; but a glossy teal plastic cooler, modern and clean - no salvage/heirloom wear. Most-seen prop (23/floor).

spore-barrel.why: clean readable oil drum, on-palette; generic - nothing says spore or this swamp (no sight-glass, no patching).

cryo-terminal.why: old restyle (no raw): ragged moss fringe and a ground slab welded into the alpha; dark, muddy, reads as a tombstone with a green eye.

nutrient-dispenser.why: old restyle: sits on a green-goo slab (the tombstone plinth); the dispenser itself is a flat teal slab, glow is noise not one accent.

wall-screen.why: reads as a TV, but a clean modern flatscreen with an ECG line - off-lore (G2: no glass jars, no coil); also worn by every generator.

hydro-recycler.why: unreadable at any scale: a speckled dark shrub on a white puddle. Moss + ground slab; does not read as a machine at all.

weapons-locker.why: a 10px-wide sickly-green stick at 32px; no form, no door read, mottled like moss.

supply-cabinet.why: reads as an open cupboard but thin (sliver at 32px) and duplicates the crate/rack teal.

work-desk.why: modern office desk with a PC monitor (prompt forbids it); low and tiny at game scale, mostly empty pixels.

chair.why: wiry modern chair, thin legs vanish at 32px. OWNER'S PICK (08-20) - kept, not regenerated.

storage-rack.why: chunky, reads as shelving; a pale slab top and teal sameness with the crate/cabinet.

crew-bunk.why: reads as a bed at game scale, warm/cool split works; green rim glow slightly loud.

mess-bench.why: thin dark plank on two stubs, broken-looking; most of the 64px cell is empty.

mess-table.why: chunky worn-wood table, reads well, on-palette, fits salvage tone.

bio-planter.why: lime-green cube is the loudest flat colour in the set (breaks G3 muted frame); plant reads.

spore-node.why: on-lore organism with one essence glow; reads at game scale.
